column3: the expression “UK retail investor” means a person who is one (or more) of the following: (A) a client, as defined in point (7) of Article 2(1) of UK MiFIR, who is not a UK  Professional Client; or (B) a customer within the meaning of the provisions of the FSMA and any rules or regulations made under the FSMA to implement Directive (EU) 2016/97 (such rules or regulations, as amended), where that customer would  not qualify as a UK Professional Client; or (C) not a qualified investor as defined in Article 2 of the UK Prospectus Regulation; and
